init_vllm_agent: initialize a VLLMAgent with a model_id, agent_prompt, tokenizer, tensor_parallel_size, and temperature for LLM-based agent generation
get_action_batch: call get_action on a VLLMAgent instance to generate LLM outputs for a batch of dialogue histories
format_chat_prompts: use the VLLMAgent tokenizer to apply chat templates to dialogue histories with a system prompt
review_vllm_agent_class: review the VLLMAgent class and its get_action method for batch LLM generation from dialogue histories
refactor_sampling_params: refactor the VLLMAgent sampling parameters to adjust temperature, max_tokens, or top_p settings
